title: How to Read Space Images | Space Atlas
description: A photograph, a simulation, and an artist's concept can all be useful — but they don't make the same claim. Learn to tell them apart.
ogDescription: Observation, model/simulation, or illustration — a useful space image tells you what kind of truth it shows.
jsonldDescription: A guide for students to distinguish an observed image, a model or simulation, and an artist's illustration in space-science media.
